subject.title: bug(cost): mid-session writes to bootstrap-injected files trigger cacheWrite spiral on long agentic sessions; bootstrap-cache.ts shipped for #43532 is content-equality, not session-freeze

question: Which prompt-cache contract should own mid-session edits to bootstrap-injected files: session-freeze, configurable dynamic-file placement, or documentation-only guidance?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the durable fix changes model-facing session context, provider-cache expectations, and likely config semantics, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Ship additive cache-stability mode
options.body: Add an opt-in session-freeze or dynamic-file contract with unchanged defaults, schema/docs/tests, and explicit prompt-cache semantics.

options.title: Use dynamic-file tracker as canonical
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/65438 the implementation path and keep this issue as production cost evidence until that lands.

options.title: Document current live behavior
options.body: Decline a platform cache-stability mode for now and document that volatile bootstrap files should not be edited mid-session on cached Anthropic models.

recommendation.title: Ship additive cache-stability mode
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in session-freeze or dynamic-file contract with unchanged defaults, schema/docs/tests, and explicit prompt-cache semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter introduced the bootstrap snapshot cache and closed the earlier session-freeze request, so he is the best available owner for clarifying the intended contract.
